question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**to**'**.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• We use the **present perfect tense** to talk about things that **started** in the **past** and are **still true now**.
 
• We can add ‘**always**’ to talk about things that **never change** and are always** true** from the** past until now**.
 
• Rule: “Has/have always been” is a present perfect sentence. 

Here in the passage, the **act of residing** is still in **progress** that had **started earlier**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the other options:
 
 
• **Out** is used in **away from the inside of a place.**
 
• **From** is used to show the **place**, **direction,** or **time **that **somebody/something starts or started**
 
• **At** is used to show where **somebody/something** is or where something happens.
